children: Overview
China oncology therapeutics developer's H1 2026 revenue grew 12.1% yr/yr
Domestic commercialization revenue more than doubled, led by MEIYOUHENG and PUYOUHENG sales
Licensing revenue declined due to fewer milestone payments from AstraZeneca and ArriVent deals
Outlook
Company plans to accelerate clinical development of late-stage and innovative drug candidates
Lepu Biopharma to focus on expanding market share of approved oncology products in China
Company aims to advance preclinical molecules to IND stage as soon as practicable
Result Drivers
COMMERCIAL SALES SURGE - Co said domestic commercialization revenue more than doubled, driven by MEIYOUHENG and PUYOUHENG sales
LICENSING REVENUE DECLINE - Co attributed lower licensing revenue to fewer milestone payments from AstraZeneca and ArriVent deals
PIPELINE ADVANCEMENT - Co said multiple oncology assets progressed through clinical stages and combination therapies
